mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_bad_case (question, actual_answer, failure_reason, mode, optimization, status, create_time) VALUES (#{question}, #{actualAnswer}, #{failureReason}, #{mode}, #{optimization}, #{status}, sysdate())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_bad_case ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_bad_case SET status=#{status}, update_time=sysdate() WHERE id=#{id}
